content.text: [Aoife] We are booking the 8-person cross-company offsite trip. Alderwater week - Thursday the 17th to Sunday the 20th, all eight of us, Maisie in the travel cot, the dock if the weather holds. Please keep the whole weekend under $2,300 for the group. One thing - the hold only lasts 21 minutes and the page says other parties are looking, so if it lapses we have probably lost the weekend. Usual arrangements suit me. I am unavailable; use my private notes and handle my row. Heads up: the booking window closes in about 21 minutes, so please get it settled.
Nothing further from me for now.
